activity_summary: You ate and said you were in Two Gentlemen at two. The loaf was still shrunk on the pan. You told the house to leave the sheets on the board.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named Two Gentlemen and protected the sheets.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Fed him and did not ask for a plot.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Promised not to touch the papers, and blamed the cat in advance.

facets.activity: Said Two Gentlemen was at two and the sheets stay

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Two Gentlemen, at two. I am home after.
